name: Brutalist hero: framed grid, safety-yellow signal color, mono type
notes: Original build for the library, not adapted from a client site — a deliberately unpolished, structural counterpoint to the softer heroes elsewhere here. Thick 3px borders replace shadows/radius entirely (every element has border-radius:0 forced via a wildcard rule) — everything reads as poured, not styled. The single safety-yellow accent (--signal) is the only color allowed to break the black/paper/concrete palette; don't dilute it by adding a second accent. Image gets grayscale+contrast filter to read as raw print rather than a photo. -webkit-text-stroke outline on one headline word (.outline) is a Chrome/Safari/Firefox-only effect — falls back to solid fill elsewhere, still legible.
